purpose: Supplemental reference starting compositions demonstrating that unusual biochemistries use the same Adaptive Research graph. These are validation/balance seeds, not named playable species tech trees.

profiles.description: Comparable pre-FTL early-space civilization with native ammonia-rich carbon biochemistry.
profiles.historical_notes: Begins with native ammonia biochemistry understood, but advanced ammonia nutrient synthesis, closed ecology, bioindustry, and biosphere branches remain to emerge from conditions/need.

profiles.description: Comparable pre-FTL early-space civilization with native cryogenic hydrocarbon-solvent carbon biology.
profiles.historical_notes: Cryogenic biology is normal for this population; warm terrestrial conditions may be the hostile environment rather than the reverse.

profiles.description: Rare speculative silicon-centered/mineral-structural early-space civilization using the same public possibility graph.
profiles.historical_notes: Silicon-centered research begins from native scientific history, not from discovering alien silicon life. Its future mineral repair, biofabrication, habitat, and computation paths remain adaptive.
